changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 9, item 3: broke the daemon/ <-> onboard/ import-cycle cluster. ServiceInstallAnswers now lives in daemon/environment.ts (the file that builds it), so daemon/unit.ts and daemon/install.ts both depend on it one-directionally instead of on daemon/install.ts. The idempotent file-write ledger (FileLedger, TransparentFileLedger, ensureDirectory, ensureTextFile, writeTextFile) moved from onboard/ledger.ts to the neutral platform/file-ledger.ts, since daemon/install.ts's runDaemonInstall and onboard/run.ts's runOnboard both need the identical write tracking. onboard/ledger.ts's remaining exports (snapshotFiles, recordFileTreeChanges, FileSnapshot) had zero callers anywhere in the package, so the now-empty file is deleted rather than left as a dead stub. Internal reorg only; no runtime or published-API change.
